panel.source_interpretation: Nine ordinary curves: three distinct deterministic qualifying coefficient pairs at each of the three source order scales. This explicitly expands curve replication without dropping a source rung; no statistical independence of the curves is asserted. One fixed pair-table engine is tested; polynomial/Groebner/S4 solver behavior remains untested.
panel.count_semantics: Target rows are mathematical samples, not multiplied by methods/repetitions. Calibration measures four fixed start strategies on every row with three cold repetitions; holdout measures those four plus the real and null routers. Replays and matched nulls are not new independent targets. All controls and failed construction attempts have separate records.

complete_finite_contract.chart_engine: Exact both-sign interval/digit sets with factored membership descriptions; materialized affine pair-table timed engine and projective exhaustive checker. No S4/Groebner/polynomial-solver result or replacement estimator.
complete_finite_contract.policy_selection: For every curve, primitive predicate i and side v, require at least32 calibration targets in that cell in each of its six streams. For each stream choose j_cell in{0,1,2,3} minimizing the sum of c_jt over that cell; tie smaller j. Compare the sum of those selected cell costs over six streams with the sum of costs of each stream's already calibration-selected j_star on the same cell. Select the (i,v) minimizing this pooled positive-denominator ratio by exact cross multiplication; tie(i,v), false before true. Store all eligible/ineligible candidates, the six j_cell values and all sums. Run the identical definition for the null feature association. Freeze the single curve-level real/null H1 witness and six cell-chart assignments before holdout. Zero denominator is invalid measurement; no eligible stratum is explicit insufficient information, without replacing a cell or sampling again.
complete_finite_contract.policy_custody: All3 calibration RUNs, required controls and raw policy-score records must be complete. The actual calibration/policy snapshot and subsequent calibration-integrity decision-only ledger TASK-20260909-341475 with DEC-20260909-406441 must be published. The separate holdout activation names the actual policy bundle SHA256, calibration source/claim/record hashes and immutable implementation lock. If any binding is absent, changed or inconsistent, refuse holdout before sampling any heldout target.
complete_finite_contract.certificate_quarantine: The oracle/checker process passes no solution/count/rank/heldout cost data to the selector or timed router. For each calibration RUN, finalize calibration-measurements.json containing only permitted calibration features/timing/setup/score data, then seal policy-core.json with its exact measurement hash and chosen routers/fixed/H1 records. Only after that core is sealed may the private checker flush complete oracle tables. Final RUN manifests bind core/measurement outputs. The global selected-policies.json is assembled after all three RUNs and copies sealed cores exactly, binding their actual hashes and RUN manifests; it never reselects or hashes later global summaries. Holdout samples/timings are generated only after the actual published bundle and activation.
complete_finite_contract.cost: For curve c, seed s and strategy a: C_total(a,c,s)=C_acq(c,s)+C_cal(a,c,s)+C_hold_mid(a,c,s)+C_postverify(a,c,s), with all stage attributions explicitly disjoint inside each term. Learned real/null policies pay their entire allowed calibration induction, including shared chart labels charged fully. A fixed S_j has no learned-policy training charge, but pays every input/correctness/certificate prerequisite it uses. Cost to measure the other fixed comparators is retained in experiment-audit totals; the hindsight minimum is explicitly an optimistic comparator, not an uncharged selectable oracle provided to the candidate.

source_thresholds.instrument: All ordinary slots, six RUN units, controls, exact source/policy/lock bindings and independent certificates must be complete and valid. Candidate/fixed strategies have identical target existential statuses and every returned/audited solution is correct. No lower final informative rank than the minimizing fixed benchmark for each paired instance. Memory stays within8GiB and base/overlap/storage conventions match. Preserve Q-identifiability against the same paired benchmark, with exact row-span certificates; absence of a complete Q recovery caps the claim at target-decomposition cost. Informative-rank comparisons are conditioned on the same explicit charged free-input row space, with input-derived Q recovery labeled separately.
source_thresholds.primary: The source20% cost target is met only if R_c<=0.8 for every one of the9 declared curves, with each seed/rung outcome retained; this is a finite measured target, not a universal expectation theorem. Report aggregate rung ratios additionally, never instead of failed cells.
source_thresholds.H1: The precommitted curve-level primitive predicate/side must have a heldout selected-chart conditional active-query/recovery cost ratio<=0.75 against its calibration-selected fixed j_star, pooling the same six streams, and at least32 heldout targets in that cell per stream. Report every predicate/side too, but do not switch the H1 witness after holdout. No eligible stratum means insufficient information for H1, not a hidden success or global rejection. An active conditional gap alone does not establish that it survives charges: a positive H1 interpretation also requires the primary complete-cost criterion and all controls. No-eligible-stratum is explicit insufficient information, with no new data or reselection.
source_thresholds.null_interpretation: For a coordinate-predictive routing interpretation also require the real policy’s selected-chart loss computed from the common measured fixed-chart target-cost matrix to be<=0.95 of the null policy’s analogous loss per curve and real<null in at least5 of6 stream pairs. This is a supplemental predeclared finite separation guard, not a replacement for R_c<=0.8. It excludes extra permutation-construction overhead from this diagnostic only; both full costs retain that overhead. A full-cost gain without null separation is reported as finite algorithmic gain not separated from the null, not as a geometry/ECDLP claim.
source_thresholds.falsification: After a complete valid controlled panel, failure of the source R_c<=0.8 condition is negative only for this fixed chart/solver/policy family and parameters. A valid failure of H1 or null separation has its own scoped disposition. Missing source constructions, insufficient strata, invalid checks, wrong group law, broken lock, timing failure or operational interruption are incomplete/invalid, never evidence that all routing or the source lead is impossible.
source_thresholds.no_approval: All criteria are preregistered future tests. Current design performs no sample, benchmark, solver, rank computation, formal proof or validation run.

complete_finite_contract.information_boundary: Before attributing any informative rank to decomposition, independently account for all equality/negation information in the public input records under the declared lookup operation set: R_i=±R_j; R_i in{O,±P,±Q}; and R_i equal to a signed base representative. Build the corresponding exact modular rows from recorded a,beta and known signs, verify their group identities, and charge the lookup/history/check work equally to every arm. Carry already available calibration free rows into the heldout baseline without exposing solved scalars to selector/router. Report each arm’s added rank modulo this common row space and whether Q was already identifiable from input collisions; such information is never credited to routing or treated as free source savings. No arbitrary uncharged discrete-log or higher-cost relation oracle is assumed.
